mapper.select: SELECT serve.id, serve.sale_status, serve.serve_item_id, item.name AS serve_item_name, item.serve_type_id, serve.region_id, item.reference_price, serve.price, serve.is_hot, serve.create_time, serve.update_time, type.name AS serve_type_name FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON item.serve_type_id = type.id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId}

SELECT type.id serve_type_id, serve.city_code, type.serve_type_icon, type.name serve_type_name, type.sort_num serve_type_sort_num, item.id serve_item_id, item.name serve_item_name, item.sort_num serve_item_sort_num, item.serve_item_icon, serve.id serve_id
FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON item.serve_type_id = type.id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId} and serve.sale_status=2 order by type.sort_num, item.sort_num

SELECT type.id serve_type_id, type.name serve_type_name, type.serve_type_icon serve_type_img, type.sort_num serve_type_sort_num FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON item.serve_type_id = type.id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId} and serve.sale_status=2 order by type.sort_num, item.sort_num

SELECT serve.city_code city_code, item.name serve_item_name, serve.id serve_item_id, item.unit , item.detail_img detail_img, serve.price , item.img serve_item_img, serve.id FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON item.serve_type_id = type.id WHERE serve.region_id = #{regionId} and serve.sale_status=2 AND serve.is_hot = 1
select serve.region_id from serve where is_hot = 1 and sale_status = 2

SELECT serve.city_code city_code, item.name serve_item_name, serve.serve_item_id, item.unit , item.detail_img detail_img, serve.price , item.img serve_item_img, serve.id FROM serve inner JOIN serve_item AS item ON serve.serve_item_id = item.id inner JOIN serve_type AS type ON item.serve_type_id = type.id WHERE serve.id = #{id} and serve.sale_status=2
select serve.id from serve where serve.sale_status = 2
